Chapter 1372 - 2: The Void

Chapter 1372: Chapter 2: The Void

Therefore.

The downfall and death of almost all Time Lords stem from themselves.

...

"The future..."

Lin Yuan, utilizing the Myriad Realms Gate, looked at one future timeline after another.

At this moment, he could sense that he could not only observe these timelines but also travel through the Myriad Realms Gate.

However, the future is uncertain and filled with infinite variables.

Perhaps a certain future timeline might suddenly collapse at any moment, causing all living beings to perish completely.

Only past timelines are the most stable, present timelines are next, and some future timelines could collapse at any time.

...

"Moreover, now if I’m to travel and descend onto the next source world, I can actively choose which vessel to descend upon, rather than arriving completely at random."

Lin Yuan thought to himself.

This function is greatly helpful for him, at least it allows him to decide his ’starting point’ upon arrival.

He won’t have to face catastrophic starting points, among other situations.

Even with the ability to view timelines, Lin Yuan can choose vessels with special physiques and bloodlines to descend upon.

Choosing a higher starting point for himself.

Of course.

Whether it’s the prior random descent.

Or the current active descent.

All chosen vessels must be completely dead.

If they are still alive, Lin Yuan’s forced takeover would trigger the vessel’s instinctive resistance.

This would then attract the attention of the source world’s consciousness, etc.

Each source world, or dimensional space, strictly repels external time life forms.

The Lord of Heaven Light paid countless costs to integrate into the second source world.

"Not bad, not bad."

Lin Yuan nodded.

Feeling joyful.

The two major ’functions’ unlocked by the Myriad Realms Gate are extremely practical.

They can significantly assist the current Lin Yuan.

...

"Let me take a look."

Lin Yuan followed the source world coordinates deep within the Myriad Realms Gate, gazing at the third source world.

This time, the Myriad Realms Gate did not issue any warnings, indicating that this source world can no longer truly threaten Lin Yuan, who has stepped into the Thirteenth Level.

Buzz~ Dividing a strand of his Primordial Spirit, Lin Yuan arrived outside a vast world through the source world coordinates deep within the Myriad Realms Gate.

This vast world is visibly beyond the previous two source worlds, with most areas shrouded in fog, and Lin Yuan vaguely sensed that there are three locked timelines within the world.

In other words, within this source world, it is estimated to have three Time Lord-level time life forms.

Only Time Lords in the Third Realm could lock their timelines and isolate themselves from all prying eyes.

Three Time Lords?

Lin Yuan’s pupils slightly contracted.

Immediately determining that this source world is out of the ordinary.

Normally speaking, within a complete dimension space’s Great Destruction Cycle, it is rare to see a Time Lord of the Third Realm.

Because compared to the accumulation a Time Lord needs, the dimension space’s Great Destruction Cycle is exceedingly short.

But there are no absolutes.

For instance, like the Milky Way dimension that does not repel external time life forms from entering a distinctly special dimension space, it could possibly attract a Third Realm Time Lord to reside.

Additionally, according to the source worlds Lin Yuan has come into contact with, their differences from the normal top-notch dimension spaces.

The former, due to the perfect aura presence, the time required for a Great Destruction Cycle far exceeds that of top-notch dimension spaces.

If a source world’s Great Destruction Cycle is long enough, tantamount to tens or hundreds of Great Destruction Cycles of a normal top-notch dimension space.

It could potentially give rise to a Third Realm Time Lord.

The third source world Lin Yuan is currently observing surpasses the two previous source worlds.

This sensation comes from the source world itself, not from the three Time Lord-level time life forms within it.

"Source world..."

Lin Yuan’s expression grew solemn.

After becoming a time life form, Lin Yuan’s perspective naturally differs from before.

He is aware of such dimensional spaces’ uniqueness, like the Chaos Void, the Taixu Dimension, and other top-tier dimensional spaces, there are still many.

But the source world?

Lin Yuan never learned about such worlds from the seven Time Lords within the Chaos Void.

The source world is remarkably special.

The Lord of Heaven Light detected the uniqueness of the second source world, preferring to endure outside until the source world’s Great Destruction, then wait for rebirth, willing to pay a high cost to integrate.

Each source world operates differently from other top-tier dimensional spaces, providing significant help to Time Lords of the Third Realm.

In reality, Time Lords of the Third Realm show little interest in top-tier dimensional spaces.

Ordinary First Realm and Second Realm Thirteenth Level time life forms yearn to explore more dimensional spaces to enrich themselves.

But Time Lords? Their pursuits differ from regular time life forms.

Lin Yuan values the essence operations of source worlds because it relates to the transformation of his internal universe.

Only by integrating more essence operations from source worlds can the internal universe approach perfection.

...

"Three Time Lords, no wonder, if not yet stepping into the Thirteenth Level, wanting to explore, the Myriad Realms Gate would issue a warning."

Lin Yuan’s expression became thoughtful, if he were still at the Twelfth Level, no matter how strong, capable of rivaling Thirteenth Level time life forms.

Yet facing a Time Lord, there still exists a risk of several true forms being affected.

The means of Time Lords cannot be judged by common reasoning, some roads of special Time Lords are terrifyingly powerful.

However, these threats to Lin Yuan, who is already a time life form, are not considered real threats.

At most, it is the loss of the true form in the third source world, as for the true forms in several other source worlds, they remain mostly unaffected.
